All mode and pixel timelines differ somewhere; no time or frame offset is fitted. The CLI exits 1.

All 300 private RGB captures and their timing metadata remain identical to the prior core. The original release hold and baseline remain unchanged.

All 274 selected public headless contracts pass; local native boundary witnesses include the AGB0/AGB startup-compatibility profiles.
